name: Guayaquil
tagline: Ecuador's port city and gateway to the Galápagos
summary: Guayaquil is Ecuador's largest city and main gateway to the Galápagos. Walk the riverside Malecón 2000, climb the 444 steps of Las Peñas to the lighthouse, see the iguanas lounging in Seminario Park, and eat encebollado and crab before your flight to the islands.
seasonNote: June to November is dry and cooler; January to April is hot and rainy.
arrival: José Joaquín de Olmedo airport is 10 minutes from the centre.
gettingAround: Uber and taxis; the Metrovía bus covers the centre.
cashTip: Ecuador uses the US dollar. Carry small bills; change for 20s can be hard.
buyTip: Panama hats (made in Ecuador) and chocolate.
baseArea: Centro near the Malecón or Samborondón
